title: More portal stones, sorted by land
changes: 14 new portal stones: Millbrook Mill, the Hunter's Camp, Kel Ashar, Palmshade Oasis, Mirage Wells, Jackal Springs, Blackwater Fen, Thane's Rest, Vulture's Roost, the Cinnabar Pits, Tunneltop, Mosslight Fen, Tollcross and the Pilgrims' Way.
Every land now has at least two stones, and each new stone has its own bounty board.
The travel list is grouped by land, with the land you stand in on top.
A stone's ring now shows one rune block for each stone of its own land.
